newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian lev closes firmer on c-bank support.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian lev closes firmer on c-bank support.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed steady from midday levels between 226.50-227.50 per dollar but firmer than 229-230 in the morning due to active dollar sales by the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB), dealers said.

"The central bank has been selling dollars since the start of today's trade, which amid the low foreign currency demand contributed to the lev's advance by around three levs (against the dollar) since the morning," one dealer said.
The BNB sold dollars throughout most of the day, starting at 229 levs and lowereing its quotations to around 227 levs at midday, dealers said.
Foreign currency demand was moderate, and supply from the BNB was further boosted by some banks' dollar sales, which pared long forex positions, traders said.
Central bank officials were not immediately available for comment. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
